items.name: CommitResponse
items.summary: `CommitResponse` is the result of committing a transaction via a catalog. The committer uses this type to indicate whether or not the commit was successful or conflicted. The kernel then transforms the associated [`Transaction`] into the a…

items.name: CommitType
items.summary: The type of commit operation being performed. This communicates to the committer whether this is a table creation or a write to an existing table, and whether the table is catalog-managed.

methods.name: is_create
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this is a create-table commit (version 0).

methods.name: requires_catalog_committer
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this commit includes a catalog-managed operation, including upgrade/downgrade.

items.name: CommitMetadata
items.summary: `CommitMetadata` bundles the metadata about a commit operation. This includes the commit path, version, and protocol/metadata state of the table being committed to. Catalog committers can use the protocol and metadata getters to validate o…

methods.name: commit_type
methods.summary: The type of commit operation being performed.

methods.name: has_domain_metadata_change
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this commit includes a domain metadata change for the given domain name.

methods.name: has_metadata_change
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this commit changes the table's metadata.

methods.name: has_protocol_change
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this commit changes the table's protocol.

methods.name: has_reader_feature
methods.summary: Check if the effective protocol has a specific reader feature by name.

methods.name: has_writer_feature
methods.summary: Check if the effective protocol has a specific writer feature by name.

methods.name: in_commit_timestamp
methods.summary: The in-commit timestamp for the commit. Note that this may differ from the actual commit file modification time.

methods.name: max_published_version
methods.summary: The maximum published version of the table.

methods.name: metadata_configuration
methods.summary: Get the raw metadata configuration for the effective metadata. Returns `None` if no metadata is set.

methods.name: published_commit_path
methods.summary: The commit path is the absolute path (e.g. s3://bucket/table/_delta_log/{version}.json) to the published delta file for this commit.

methods.name: staged_commit_path
methods.summary: The staged commit path is the absolute path (e.g. s3://bucket/table/_delta_log/{version}.{uuid}.json) to the staged commit file.

methods.name: table_root
methods.summary: The root URL of the table being committed to.

methods.name: version
methods.summary: The version to which the transaction is being committed.
